answer: Like a rhizomatic mycelium anchoring a delicate lotus against a turbulent zephyr, consensus grows through transitive trust graphs. Divining true peers like ancient yarrow stalks, personalized PageRank requires agents to stake scarce cryptographic bonds along verified edges. Sybil swarms face superlinear attacker cost: multiplying counterfeit identities without genuine incoming trust partitions them into powerless, isolated subgraphs.
